svg.title: Adapter
svg.desc: Adapter. Wrap an incompatible interface so existing code can use it unchanged: the classic fix for a third-party or legacy API. Step 1, Interfaces that don't fit: Checkout expects a PaymentGateway; the LegacyPay SDK has another shape, so it doesn't fit. Step 2, Wrap it in an adapter: LegacyPayAdapter implements PaymentGateway, holds the SDK and translates the call both ways. Step 3, Translate units and errors: Decimals depend on the currency (JPY 0, EUR 2, BHD 3), and a DECLINED reply becomes PaymentDeclined. Step 4, Swap providers freely: AcmePayAdapter plugs a second provider in behind the same interface. Checkout's code never changes.

g.text: Checkout expects a PaymentGateway; the LegacyPay SDK has another shape, so it doesn't fit.
LegacyPayAdapter implements PaymentGateway, holds the SDK and translates the call both ways.
Decimals depend on the currency (JPY 0, EUR 2, BHD 3), and a DECLINED reply becomes PaymentDeclined.
AcmePayAdapter plugs a second provider in behind the same interface. Checkout's code never changes.
its own error type, no provider code
cost: one more class per provider
Facade: a new, simpler interface over a subsystem
